CredentialRetrieval.description:
Set the type of credentials to secure data.
Valid values: Prompt, Store, Integrated, None Prompt - Requires the user to provide credentials at runtime for the connection. Store - Credentials securely stored in the report server are used to access the data source. Integrated - Uses the current user's Windows credentials to access the data source. None - Credentials are provided directly in the connection string for access to the data source.

Password.description: Specifies the password of connection credentials

Prompt.description: Specifies the text that prompts users for a username and password

UserName.description: Specifies the username of connection credentials

WindowsCredentials.description: Set to true to use Windows credentials when connecting to the datasource

ServerType.description:
Specify the server type.
Valid values: SQL, SQLCE, OLEDB, ODBC, Oracle, XML, SSAS, PostgreSQL, MySQL, WebApi. Note: If the ServerType is set to 'WebApi', the fields 'CredentialRetrieval' and 'WindowsCredentials' are not required fields. Additionally, the following WebApiDatasource property should only be included when ServerType is 'WebApi'. Otherwise, it should be ignored.

CustomProperties.description:
Specify the custom properties required for the Oracle database connection.

Note:The CustomProperties field is required only when the ServerType is set to Oracle. For all other server types, this field can be omitted.

WebApiDatasource.description: Specifies the settings required to configure a Web API data source.

SecurityType.description: Specifies the security type. Valid values: `BasicHttpAuthentication`, `None`. Note: - Select `None` under `Authentication Type` if your data source supports authentication directly through the REST API URL. No additional credentials are required. - If your data source requires a `username` and `password` for authentication, choose `BasicHTTPAuthentication` under Authentication Type.

Valid values: `Hourly` `Daily` `Weekly` `Monthly` `Yearly`. \n\n Note: If you chose the schedule type as `Monthly`, provide a values to the MonthlySchedule property, and leave the (HourlySchedule, DailySchedule, WeeklySchedule and YearlySchedule) properties empty.

HourlySchedule.description: Runs the schedules on an hourly basis.

DailySchedule.description: Runs the schedules on a daily basis.

ApiHourlySchedule.description: Runs the schedules on an hourly basis.

ApiDailySchedule.description: Runs the schedules on a daily basis.

RecurrenceType.description: Specifies the recurrence type, whether the schedule recurs every day or every working day.  Valid values: `EveryNdays` `EveryWeekday`. \n\n Note: If you chose the recurrence type as EveryNdays, provide a value to the EveryNdays property, and leave the (EveryWeekday) property empty.

EveryNdays.description: Specifies the day interval the schedule recurs. \n\n For example: If you provide 2, the schedule recurs every 2 days.

EveryWeekday.description: For the schedule to recur every working day, set to true.

ApiWeeklySchedule.description: Runs the schedule on a weekly basis.

RecurrenceWeeks.description: Specifies the number of weeks the schedule recurs. \n\n For example: If you provide 2, the schedule will recur every 2 weeks.

RecurrenceDays.description: Specifies the list of  days the schedule recurs. Valid values `Sunday` `Monday` `Tuesday` `Wednesday` `Thursday` `Friday` `Saturday`. \n\n For example: If you provide `Sunday`, the schedule will recur sunday's of every 2 weeks.

ApiMonthlySchedule.description: Runs the schedule on a monthly basis.

RecurrenceType.description: Specifies the recurrence type, whether the schedule recurs on a specific day or on the customized day basis. Valid values: `DayRecurrence` `CustomRecurrence` \n\n Note: If you chose the recurrence type as DayRecurrence, provide a value to the DayRecurrence property and leave the (CustomRecurrence) property empty.

DayRecurrence.description: The schedule recurs on the day specified on the month interval.

CustomRecurrence.description: The schedule recurs on the customized day of the specified month interval.

ApiYearlySchedule.description: Runs the schedules on a yearly basis.

YearInterval.description: Specifies the number of years the schedule recurs. \n\n For example: If you provide 5, the schedule will recur every 5 years.

RecurrenceType.description: Specifies the recurrence type, whether the schedule recurs on a month basis or on the customized month basis. Valid values: `MonthRecurrence` `CustomRecurrence`. \n\n Note: If you chose the recurrence type as MonthRecurrence, provide a value to the MonthRecurrence property, and leave the (CustomRecurrence) property empty.

MonthRecurrence.description: The schedule recurs on the month and number of years specified in YearInterval property.

CustomRecurrence.description: The schedule recurs in the customized month based on the number of years provided in the YearInterval property.

DayInterval.description: Specifies the number of day interval the schedule recurs. \n\n For example: If you provide 10, the schedule will recur every 10th day.

MonthInterval.description: Specifies the number of month interval the schedule recurs. \n\n For example: If you provide 3, the schedule will recur 10th day of every 3 months.

WeekOfMonth.description: Specifies the week of the month the schedule recurs. Valid values: `first` `second` `third` `fourth` `last`. \n\n For example: If you provide second, the schedule will recur on the second week.

DayOfWeek.description: Specifies the day of the week the schedule recurs. Valid values: `day` `weekday` `weekendday` `Sunday` `Monday` `Tuesday` `Wednesday` `Thursday` `Friday` `Saturday`. \n\n For example: If you provide Sunday, the schedule will recur on the second week of sunday.

MonthInterval.description: Specifies the number of month interval the schedule recurs. \n\n For example: If you provide 5, the schedule will recur second week of sunday's of every 5 months.

ApiYearlyScheduleMonthRecurrence.description: The schedule recurs on the month and number of years specified in YearInterval property.

MonthOfYear.description: Specifies the month the schedule recurs. **Note:**When using this grant type, a valid OAuth JWT token must be provided in the request header using the Authorization scheme: Authorization: Bearer <token>.

The type of credentials used to authorize the request for an access token.
Value allowed is Embed_Secret.

Embed_Secret.description: Specifies the embed secret key used to generate a REST API access token. The embed secret key is generated from the Bold Reports server settings. Either the UMS embed secret or the site embed secret can be provided.

ItemId.description: Specifies the unique identifier of the report.

TargetSiteDetails.description: Specifies the information about the target site where the report has to be published.

PublishType.description:
Specifies the type of publish action.
The possible values are internal or external.

ItemVersion.description: Specifies the version of the report to be published. </br></br>If this property is not provided, the latest version of the report is published. If a version is specified, the corresponding version of the report is published.</br>For example, if a report has versions 1, 2, and 3, specifying `ItemVersion` as `2` publishes version 2 of the report.

ClientId.description: Specifies the client identifier of the target site.

SiteIdentifier.description: Specifies the site identifier of the target site.

CategoryName.description: Specifies the category name of the report in the target site.

Description.description: Specifies the description of the report in the target site.

UseSourceItemName.description: If set to true, uses the source item name as the report name in the target site. If set to false, uses the value provided in the ReportName property as the report name in the target site.

LockReport.description: If set to true, locks the report in the target site. If set to false, does not lock the report in the target site.

Datasources.description: Specifies the information about the datasources used in the report.

DataSets.description: Specifies the information about the datasets used in the report.

Id.description: Specifies the ID of the datasource.

IsLocked.description: If set to true, locks the datasource in the target site. If set to false, does not lock the datasource in the target site.

Id.description: Specifies the ID of the dataset.

IsLocked.description: If set to true, locks the dataset in the target site. If set to false, does not lock the dataset in the target site.

StatusMessage.description: Returns the status message from the API.

Name.description: Specifies the name of the external site.

ClientId.description: Specifies the client identifier of the external site.

ClientSecret.description: Specifies the client secret of the external site.

SiteUrl.description: Specifies the URL of the external site.
